verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh sends registrable webhooks (e.g. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED), and every webhook carries a `webhook-id` header that the docs say to use as an idempotency key, which covers deduplicating retried notifications. Nothing in the pack documents verifying that a webhook really came from ComplyAdvantage, such as signatures or HMAC checks. missing for 10: webhook signature/authenticity verification documentation, retry/delivery semantics detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
